needed.evidence: informal_path_under_1m with obstructions and trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, dedicated sidewalk at least 1 metre wide along the right side with adequate lighting and regular maintenance to accommodate pedestrians safely.

needed.evidence: goods and items partly block the informal path
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the footpath remains clear of goods and informal market activities to provide a safe, usable pathway for pedestrians.
Repair and level the uneven sections of the informal path, and pave it to eliminate trip hazards and create a safer walking environment.
Install a refuge island at the crossing to ensure pedestrians can safely wait midway across the busy road.

needed.evidence: markings are faint and hard to see
needed.suggestion: Repaint the zebra crossing markings with high-visibility paint and install traffic signals for pedestrian use to ensure drivers stop and pedestrians have a safe crossing space.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs visible at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps and raised platforms at the crossing points to provide a seamless transition for pedestrians, including those using wheelchairs and strollers.

needed.evidence: few street lights on an urban road
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights along this section of the road to improve visibility and safety for both vehicles and pedestrians during low-light conditions.
